objective:
Goal- Research the cause of the below listed automated pets in the game Fren Pet failing to start Training Camps even though they have met the pre-resequites to do so. Describe the problem, its root causes, any underlying factors and suggest a solution. Check to see if the same problem is the cause for all below listed pets or if any of the pets have a different issues than the others.

Use https://api.pet.game to get data.

Look into pets with ID numbers of-

83633

83632

83608

83626

The main site for Fren Pet game is https://pet.game and the site for automating pets is https://frenpet.ai. Pets automated by frenpet.ai have their in-game actions performed by the operator from Base Contract Address 0x065bf5a7AF15c52C91353990CC8F3d97A1595CE7

All pets are configured to start doing Attack Training Camps automatically. Pets get to do a training camp firstly when they have won ten battles/Bonks and thereafter every time they accruce an additional wins * (next training camp level)

All pets have many more wins than required to do multiple camps but have not done a single one.

Assume that the receiver of this report has full access to both the pets and the code/githubs/contracts for the game and would be able to make changes needed on any level.
